title: WriteFreely update_post auth bypass: token_ok=false and auth.is_none() required
description: writefreely_api.rs:107-118 and 169-181. Both update_post and delete_post have the same auth bypass. The auth logic checks: (1) if token matches, pass; (2) if no token AND no auth, reject; (3) if token provided but wrong, reject. But if no token is provided and any authenticated user makes the request, it passes — there is no ownership check verifying the authenticated user owns the article. Any authenticated user can update or delete any WriteFreely article by omitting the token parameter.
